John Vervaeke joins Danny Jones for a wide talk on God, religion, and what happens when we die. The title also names ghosts in the brain, a nod to how the mind shapes what we see and feel. Vervaeke is a scholar who studies wisdom and the mind.

The two work through big questions about faith, the brain, and the sense that life has deep meaning. Vervaeke draws on science and old wisdom in the same breath. Jones presses him on death and on why the hunger for meaning will not go away. Listeners get a calm, deep talk on the largest questions a person can ask.
